summary: The registrant, American Rebel Holdings, Inc., filed an 8-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with 1800 Diagonal Lending, LLC for a secured promissory note of $152,950, netting $125,000 after original issue discount and fees. The note carries scheduled monthly payments totaling $181,628 over fifteen months, with default interest at 22% per annum and contingent conversion rights at a 25% discount to market price upon an event of default, subject to a 4.99% ownership cap. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event.
